decision: Approve only these eight existing naming conventions as written; keep the other five proposed.

evidence.proposal: Eight current Gauge-backed conventions were proposed for approval; defaultValue, onValueChange, variant, tone and elevation were explicitly deferred.

limits: This is an assistant-recorded human decision, not provider-native, signed or independent review authority.
Approval binds names and semantic convention content, not component implementation or compatibility claims.
Component-specific types, native inheritance and separately approved Gauge contracts remain unchanged.
Existing wording about draft component behavior does not reopen separately approved Gauge decisions.
No API migration, token or dependency change, automatic future approval or remote delivery is authorized.

convention.name: value
convention.meaning: The selected value or displayed measurement; domain and type are component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: Expose the primary selection or magnitude.
convention.avoid: Do not infer editability, numeric universality or shared normalization.

convention.name: size
convention.meaning: Component-specific dimensions through supported presets or custom dimensions.
convention.whenToUse: Choose dimensional presets or custom dimensions supported by the component.
convention.avoid: Assuming identical dimensions or accepted types across components; Gauge numeric CSS-pixel support does not extend Tabs or IconButton. Gauge finite-positive validation, invalid-size behavior and any min/max policy still require review.

convention.name: label
convention.meaning: The accessible name of the control or displayed magnitude.
convention.whenToUse: The public API owns an explicit accessible-name input.
convention.avoid: Assuming Surface has this prop or using it as a generic visible caption.

convention.name: state
convention.meaning: The consumer-selected interpretation of a Gauge magnitude, independent of thresholds.
convention.whenToUse: Propose Gauge condition normal, warning, critical or muted.
convention.avoid: Visual variants, material tone, loading behavior or automatic threshold inference.

convention.name: stateText
convention.meaning: Visible non-color text describing the selected Gauge condition.
convention.whenToUse: Propose condition text, required for non-normal Gauge states by the draft union.
convention.avoid: Replacing the accessible name or the numeric equivalent.

convention.name: valueText
convention.meaning: A contextual text equivalent of the normalized displayed measurement.
convention.whenToUse: Propose a readable Gauge measurement equivalent coherent with clamping.
convention.avoid: Condition text, accessible naming or an incoherent raw out-of-range value.

convention.name: center
convention.meaning: Optional decorative, non-interactive content inside the Gauge ring.
convention.whenToUse: Propose an icon, value or short text with meaning already represented accessibly.
convention.avoid: Actions, focusable descendants, a fixed logo or the sole source of meaning.

convention.name: unavailableText
convention.meaning: Readable fallback when Gauge input is non-finite and no measurement is exposed.
convention.whenToUse: Propose non-empty unavailable-data text separately from invalid-input policy approval.
convention.avoid: Loading, disabled state, fabricated zero measurements or assuming fallback wording is approved.
